basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Project Research Scientist I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of N.M.R., All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi, has one post of Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) in an ICMR-funded project, with a stipend as per ICMR guidelines. The essential qualification is a first-class postgraduate degree in Medical Biochemistry/ Medical Biotechnology/ Molecular Biology with three years of relevant wet-lab research experience, and the age limit is up to 35 years. Applicants upload their CV with relevant documents as a single PDF through the online form by 30 November 2026, 5:00 PM.

rows.details: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS New Delhi
content_sections.text: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences is a medical institute in New Delhi. This post is advertised by Prof. S. Senthil Kumaran, Professor & Head, Department of N.M.R., AIIMS, New Delhi-110029, for a research project funded by ICMR. The notice is printed in both English and Hindi.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: First-class postgraduate degree in Medical Biochemistry/ Medical Biotechnology/ Molecular Biology, with three years of relevant wet-lab research experience. Experience in Immunology, Molecular Biology Basic knowledge in data mining, machine learning, and bioinformatics The age limit for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) post is up to 35 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS New Delhi Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical)
content_sections.text: The notice asks interested applicants to upload their CV with relevant documents through an online form. Applications must be uploaded by 30 November 2026, 5:00 PM. Open the form link given in the notice, https://forms.gle/GZoUHQ8xXnKBdmtN8 (the notice also prints it as a QR code). Combine your CV and relevant documents into a single PDF file. Upload the single PDF through the form link by 30 November 2026, 5:00 PM. CV Relevant documents (in the same single PDF as the CV) For any queries, the notice gives the email address [email protected] . This address is for queries only; applications go through the form link.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview, and the interview is in-person only. No TA (travel allowance) will be provided by the Investigators/ Institute for attending it. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.
